profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer II at American Express
profile.summary: I am a New York-based Software Engineer curious for knowledge that can lead to real world solutions. For some time I have been immersed in Full-Stack Web Development with technologies such as Node Js, React with redux Js and other Web programing skills. I also put in time in the practice of data structures and algorithms using Java and sometimes Python (this can be achieved with any language but I like using these two). I am known to be a good team player and I enjoy learning as much as sharing what I know with others.

positions.title: Software Engineer Intern
positions.description:
•Built React components working along with designers to match spec criteria
•Worked on ETL data integration in AWS RedShift databases, wrote integration and unit tests to assert my queries generated the correct columns for each CSV file in an export service.
•Learned about Docker Containers, Kubernetes, Helm and made contributions in a Kubernetes Env by transitioning containers to pods in the cluster

positions.title: Sys admin/Computer Science Lab Teacher
positions.description: •Taught fundamentals of programming using javascript and python to 7th and 8th Grade students using the tools of codehs.com developing cognitive thinking and creating early programing enthusiasts. • Managed/maintained all  of the school’s technology in both Software and Hardware.
